answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the vertex queue naming the opal that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every alias burns 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the hollow record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
